SELECT ServiceID,ServiceName,Category,UnitPrice,Unit FROM Service WHERE UnitPrice BETWEEN 10 AND 30 ORDER BY ServiceID;

SELECT b.BookingID,g.FirstName+' '+g.LastName AS GuestName,g.Nationality,b.BookingDate,d.DetailID,r.RoomNumber FROM Booking b JOIN Guest g ON b.GuestID=g.GuestID JOIN BookingDetail d ON b.BookingID=d.BookingID JOIN Room r ON d.RoomID=r.RoomID WHERE b.BookingDate>='20240101' AND b.BookingDate<'20250101' AND g.Nationality IN ('Chinese','Japanese') ORDER BY b.BookingID,d.DetailID;

SELECT g.GuestID,g.FirstName,g.LastName,b.BookingID,b.BookingDate,s.ServiceName,s.Category,bs.ServiceDate FROM Guest g LEFT JOIN Booking b ON g.GuestID=b.GuestID LEFT JOIN BookingService bs ON b.BookingID=bs.BookingID LEFT JOIN Service s ON bs.ServiceID=s.ServiceID WHERE g.Nationality='Japanese' ORDER BY s.ServiceName ASC,b.BookingDate DESC;

WITH x AS (SELECT d.RoomID,d.BookingID,d.SubTotal,d.NumNights FROM BookingDetail d JOIN Booking b ON b.BookingID=d.BookingID WHERE b.CheckInDate>='20240101' AND b.CheckInDate<'20240201') SELECT rt.RoomTypeID,rt.TypeName,COUNT(DISTINCT x.BookingID) AS TotalBookings,COALESCE(SUM(x.SubTotal),0) AS TotalRevenue,CAST(COALESCE(SUM(x.SubTotal)/NULLIF(SUM(x.NumNights),0),0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS AveragePricePerNight FROM RoomType rt LEFT JOIN Room r ON r.RoomTypeID=rt.RoomTypeID LEFT JOIN x ON x.RoomID=r.RoomID GROUP BY rt.RoomTypeID,rt.TypeName ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC,rt.TypeName ASC;

WITH x AS (SELECT g.GuestID,g.Nationality,COUNT(b.BookingID) AS Bookings FROM Guest g LEFT JOIN Booking b ON b.GuestID=g.GuestID GROUP BY g.GuestID,g.Nationality) SELECT Nationality,COUNT(*) AS NumberOfGuests,MIN(Bookings) AS MinBookingsPerGuest,MAX(Bookings) AS MaxBookingsPerGuest FROM x GROUP BY Nationality ORDER BY Nationality;

WITH roomtotal AS (SELECT BookingID,SUM(SubTotal) AS RoomRevenue FROM BookingDetail GROUP BY BookingID),servicetotal AS (SELECT BookingID,SUM(TotalCost) AS ServiceRevenue FROM BookingService GROUP BY BookingID),totals AS (SELECT g.Nationality,g.GuestID,g.FirstName+' '+g.LastName AS GuestName,COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(r.RoomRevenue,0)+COALESCE(s.ServiceRevenue,0)),0) AS TotalRevenue FROM Guest g LEFT JOIN Booking b ON b.GuestID=g.GuestID AND b.CheckInDate>='20240101' AND b.CheckInDate<'20250101' LEFT JOIN roomtotal r ON r.BookingID=b.BookingID LEFT JOIN servicetotal s ON s.BookingID=b.BookingID GROUP BY g.Nationality,g.GuestID,g.FirstName,g.LastName),ranked AS (SELECT *,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY Nationality ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC) AS rk FROM totals) SELECT Nationality,GuestID,GuestName,TotalRevenue FROM ranked WHERE rk=1 ORDER BY Nationality,GuestID;

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE addService @bookingID int,@serviceID int,@quantity int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Booking WHERE BookingID=@bookingID) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Service WHERE ServiceID=@serviceID) OR @quantity IS NULL OR @quantity<0 BEGIN PRINT 'Input values are not valid.'; RETURN 1; END; INSERT BookingService(BookingID,ServiceID,Quantity,TotalCost) SELECT @bookingID,@serviceID,@quantity,@quantity*UnitPrice FROM Service WHERE ServiceID=@serviceID; RETURN 0; END;

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER trg_PreventRoomOverbooking ON BookingDetail INSTEAD OF INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @b int,@r int,@p decimal(10,2),@ci datetime,@co datetime; DECLARE c CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT BookingID,RoomID,PricePerNight FROM inserted ORDER BY BookingID,RoomID; OPEN c; FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @b,@r,@p; WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0 BEGIN SET @ci=NULL;SET @co=NULL; SELECT @ci=CheckInDate,@co=CheckOutDate FROM Booking WHERE BookingID=@b; IF @ci IS NOT NULL AND @co IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Room WHERE RoomID=@r) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM BookingDetail WHERE BookingID=@b AND RoomID=@r) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM BookingDetail d JOIN Booking b ON b.BookingID=d.BookingID WHERE d.RoomID=@r AND b.BookingID<>@b AND b.Status<>'Cancelled' AND b.CheckInDate<@co AND b.CheckOutDate>@ci) INSERT BookingDetail(BookingID,RoomID,PricePerNight,NumNights) VALUES(@b,@r,@p,DATEDIFF(day,@ci,@co)); FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @b,@r,@p; END; CLOSE c;DEALLOCATE c; END;

UPDATE b SET TotalAmount=COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d.SubTotal) FROM BookingDetail d WHERE d.BookingID=b.BookingID),0)+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.TotalCost) FROM BookingService s WHERE s.BookingID=b.BookingID),0) FROM Booking b WHERE b.BookingID BETWEEN 10 AND 20;
